Subject: POC kickoff + next steps / SOC2 & onboarding

Hi Jamie,

Thanks again for the time today — great to learn more about Acme's goals for faster, lower-cost embeddings and chat routing. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're all aligned: 

- Goal: replace current embedding pipeline for product search, target 50% cost reduction while keeping >95% relevance.
- Success metrics: query latency < 200ms (p95), embedding throughput >= 2k qps during peak.
- Proposed POC: 4-week sandbox with a sample of product catalog (10k SKUs), Redwood Dedicated with quantization profile, and one integration sprint with your infra team.

Next steps: 
1) I'll send the onboarding checklist and invite to the sandbox (attached).
2) You mentioned security would need SOC2 and network details — Neha is looping in docs and can set up a short call.
3) Suggested kickoff: Wed 2/18 or Thu 2/19, 30 minutes to confirm data access and timeline.

Attachments: POC_onboarding_checklist.pdf

If those dates don't work, tell me your availability and we can shift. Looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Hi Jamie,

Following up again — we haven't seen activity in the sandbox and I wanted to check in before we close out the scheduling for March. A few quick options to get unstuck: 

- Quick 20-min troubleshooting call with Neha (onboarding SE) to walk through the S3 upload and allowlist steps.
- Temporary extension: we can extend the sandbox window by two weeks at no charge if your security review takes longer.
- If you prefer, we can move to a private deployment trial so security can validate controls without exposing anything externally.

If the POC is no longer a priority, no problem — please let me know so we can reallocate resources. If it is still on the roadmap, what is the best time for a short call this week?

If helpful, I've pasted the minimal checklist below: 
- Create a service account with S3 write permissions (PUT only)
- Share a sample CSV (anonymized) with product IDs + titles (up to 500 rows)
- Allowlist 34.82.0.0/16, 35.201.0.0/16

Thanks — happy to jump on the call or loop in Rafael for executive alignment if helpful.

Best regards,
